master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: Agents and dashboards may route items to explicit owner decision surfaces; the owner decides and downstream systems may not recast requests as approval.
Explicit owner approval is non-delegable, scope-bound, timeboxed or revocable, and never an order command.
The owner has final internal QTT workflow authority, but owner-approved exceptions may not override venue policy, accepted source-evidence requirements, runtime cash receipts, or live-write gates.

Owner override cannot convert external facts, runtime receipts, order receipts, source-evidence packets, replay/paper results, quantum backend outputs, profit, or advantage evidence into truth by assertion.
Dual-result review and owner review never create automatic live promotion, live reachability, order execution, runtime cash receipts, blocker reduction, or profit evidence.
Owner live-promotion review is a non-execution transition after dual-result review; it creates no real orders.
Source-dependent live and connector fields remain blocked without required accepted source packets.
Connector semantic binding consumes accepted source packets and may not create live reachability, private-state fetch, runtime cash, blocker reduction, or profit evidence.
Runtime usable cash requires receipt-backed future execution; PR #92 creates no runtime cash receipt.
No runtime agent may send live orders without risk gates and execution router authority; the execution router remains final order-submission authority.
Canary eligibility and live execution remain later gates requiring owner approval, source, connector, cash, risk, health, and order-state gates.
Replay and paper result packets must remain separate and dual-result review references both without merging.
Dual-result review is upstream of owner live-promotion review and may not itself become live authority.
Owner-review-adjacent outcomes may classify pending, blocked, rejected, retest, repair, source-evidence, connector, runtime-cash, risk, dashboard, or owner-decision-required states.
AtomicRows is inventory and authority ledger, not a trader or source of live order authority.
Single-parameter or single-algorithm trade selection is forbidden; role-complete stacks are required.
Required stack roles include SIGNAL, SCORING, NORMALIZATION, RISK, EXECUTION, CAPITAL, LATENCY, ERROR_GUARD, with repo-required QUANTUM_ADVISORY metadata.
Blocked rows may appear as diagnostics but cannot enter active selected stacks, handoff, competition, review, owner review, or live promotion.
Quantum optimizers may rank/refine static candidates and future-gated metadata only; they cannot become direct live order authority or create backend output here.
Classical execution gates and execution router remain final for any future execution release.

Do not fabricate source claims, connector semantics, runtime receipts, replay/paper results, review evidence, owner approval receipts, AtomicRows bundle creation, test pass claims, quantum backend values, profit, or advantage evidence.
